title: [review] messaging.py:130: _next_id never updated after m
description: The candidate_next_id is calculated and incremented at lines 130-137, but self._next_id is never assigned the new value. Every POST without an explicit ID receives ID=1, causing sent messages to overwrite each other in self._sent. The second message with auto-ID replaces the first, third replaces second, etc. Fix: add 'self._next_id = candidate_next_id' before the return at line 152.
close_reason: Already fixed: line 150 already contains 'self._next_id = candidate_next_id' ensuring IDs increment correctly (verified by test: 3 consecutive POSTs get IDs 1,2,3)
